description: Main source file for a Flutter-based QR code scanner app. It sets up the app theme, manages camera scanning, displays scan results, handles URL launch and clipboard copying, and provides navigation to scan history.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget that sets up the MaterialApp and theme.

classes.name: QrHistoryProvider
classes.description: Provider class for managing QR scan history stored in-memory.

classes.name: MainScreen
classes.description: Main widget displaying camera preview, scan button, and results.

classes.name: _AppDrawer
classes.description: Navigation drawer with options for history, clearing, and about dialog.

classes.name: _QrResultArea
classes.description: Widget displaying scan result with options to copy or open URL.

classes.name: HistoryScreen
classes.description: Screen showing list of previous QR scan results.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point initializing the app with a provider and launching MyApp.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for MyApp, constructing MaterialApp with theme.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new QR scan result to history, avoiding consecutive duplicates.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for MainScreen, constructing UI including camera preview, buttons, and result display.

methods.name: _launchUrl
methods.description: Attempts to open a URL using url_launcher.

methods.name: _copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies scan result text to clipboard.

methods.name: _onDetect
methods.description: Handles QR code detection from camera feed.

methods.name: _openHistory
methods.description: Navigates to the scan history screen.

methods.name: _QrResultArea
methods.description: Displays the result of QR scan, with copy and URL open options.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for various widgets displaying their respective UI components.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for HistoryScreen, shows list of previous scan results.
